_comment: Maps this repo's own CLAUDE.md rule statements to what actually enforces them, for plugins/backend-suite/bin/audit_claude_md_drift.py. Read CLAUDE.md and this file side by side before editing either.

rules.statement: gates.py parses .github/workflows/validate.yml and runs 16 of the 16 gates, with none skipped
no project literal may appear in the universal plugin; six CI rules enforce it via audit_skill_paths.py
docs/CATALOG.md is generated by bin/catalog.py and never hand-edited; CI checks it is current
capture-baselines.sh captures the behaviour-preservation oracle before a claimed refactor
the local run is the authority, not a fallback; attest.py is the one entry point and must actually be runnable
run_tests.py and gate_consumer_compat.py are among the gates, so you do not run those separately
rules._note: attest_test.py asserts against the REAL workflow that both entry points are still invoked by a gate. If either is unwired, CLAUDE.md rule 3's 'you do not run those separately' has become false and this fails rather than the advice quietly going stale.

rules.statement: opt in to running attest.py on every push with install_prepush_hook.py, and --uninstall removes it
rules._note: The test covers the three properties the rule promises — nothing installed until asked, removable, and never overwriting a hook it did not write — each paired with the positive case it must not swallow.

rules.statement: main is the integration branch; never commit, push, or merge directly to main

check.reason: process/workflow rule enforced by human discipline and branch protection settings on the git host, not by anything in this repo's own tree

rules.statement: every push, PR, and merge needs its own explicit go-ahead asked for at the moment it happens

check.reason: a conversational/process rule with no artifact in the repo to check it against

rules.statement: the main clone is often dirty with another session's work; use a worktree rather than stashing or switching

check.reason: operator behaviour, not something a script in this repo can observe or enforce
